reviews.text:
I highly recommend this lovely clinic in Little Italy!

I saw Dr. Marylin, and she was very attentive to my cat during her checkup and vaccinations. Marylin also took the time to answer my questions and concerns and explain the cost of the procedures. Thank you for taking such good care of my Chibi :)

This is my second visit to the clinic.
The first time was for an emergency appointment for my dog ​​Bo, and today was for his vaccinations.

I really love this clinic!
Thank you to Dr. Cuisinier and the entire team!

Excellent escucha actitud, contention and proactive compromise on the part of all the team, from the secretariats to the professional veterinarians (Cook and Nice heart). Reasonable pricing. Pago facilities. Hope that my best dog is an infection and can continue to eat at the restaurant for over 10 years. We decide that he knows more of the media teaching of other veterinarians in Montreal and all of them have already been the result of some confidence in his profession, willing to cobrar fortunas without having to carry cargo completely from the medical case.  (French-English --› )

Excellent listening skills, reassuring support, and proactive commitment from the entire team, from the receptionists to the veterinarians (Cuisinier and Jolicoeur). Reasonable rates. Flexible payment options. I hope my cat overcomes this infection and that I can continue to take her there for the rest of her life. It's worth noting that I've visited more than half a dozen other veterinary clinics in Montreal; all of them proved to be ethically unreliable, willing to charge exorbitant fees without fully managing the medical file.

The entire team—from the receptionists to the veterinarians (Cuisinier and Jolicoeur)—demonstrated an excellent attitude: they were attentive, supportive, and proactively committed. The pricing is reasonable, and they offer flexible payment options. I hope my cat recovers from this infection so I can continue bringing her here for the rest of her life. For context, I have visited more than half a dozen other veterinary clinics in Montreal, and all of them proved to be ethically questionable—eager to charge exorbitant fees without taking full responsibility for the medical case.
The staff are very kind, I loved it. The vet is also very kind, she listens attentively and takes the time needed with you and your pet.
Thank you so much for your professionalism, your kindness, and the excellent care you gave my cat Lulu. I am very grateful and happy to have finally found a clinic I completely trust. ❤️

Fantastic experience! The staff were friendly and helpful. They were always punctual and efficient in their respective roles. Even in an emergency, we were given priority, and our puppy received prompt treatment and excellent follow-up. And, of course, lots of treats for his delight! 🤭 We will definitely be back for his next check-up.

Thank you to the whole team! ❤️
The staff are very attentive and their prices are very reasonable! They are also very helpful during the travel process with a pet. I highly recommend this veterinary care team.

Everyone is friendly and super helpful. You are greeted with a smile. The vet is patient, carefully explains things and answers any questions you may have. The interior is clean, bright and beautiful. Two thumbs up from me and my fur baby.
Excellent service! Attentive, warm, and professional. We weren't treated like just a number. My dog ​​and I received exceptional service. Thank you to the entire team, and especially to Marie-Ève.
Highly professional, I recommend them
Very humane, excellent veterinarian. Good approach and very honest.
They speak Spanish??

This is our second time at this veterinary clinic, and I can tell you we love going there and will definitely return because Kira, our German Shepherd, adores Dr. Cuisinier. If you're looking for a trustworthy place, go for it.

My cat needed emergency surgery, and this clinic agreed to operate on him the same day, at a much more reasonable/affordable price than the veterinary hospital!
They followed up on my cat's condition after the operation, even offering me a second appointment three days later since he wasn't doing well, and they continued to call to make sure everything was progressing well.
The vet presented me with the various treatment/investigation options without pressure or judgment, and while respecting my choices. I never felt like it was just about the money.
A huge thank you to Dr. Cuisinier and her team for the excellent care! Thanks to you, my cat is alive and doing wonderfully :)

It's a lovely little independent clinic, and that's reflected in the service, the care, and the prices. I had time to discuss my pet's case during the transfer, I'm paying less than before for more personalized service, and my dog ​​is less fearful during his visits. Also, the opening hours are more convenient for my schedule. I recommend them.

Update to my initial 5-star rating. My dog ​​had blood work done on September 4th, and it's now September 20th. I've had four follow-up appointments, and I still haven't received the results. Each time, they say, "We'll call you back," but they never do. It's disappointing.
Perfect experience
Our two small pups get excellent care at Soins Veterinaires Petite Italy.
A superb experience, despite the urgency.
Very quick, attentive and caring. Showed nothing but love to my cat!
Amazing experience. Everyone was super friendly.
A lovely experience! Dr. Cuisiner is great - and the staff were all very friendly!
Great team and efficient service! Very grateful for their work, they answered all my questions and met all my expectations.

I have never, in my entire life, met such empathetic, gentle, understanding, warm, and honest veterinarians. My 20-and-a-half-year-old cat suddenly seemed to be dying this morning. We went to the clinic not knowing if we would be seen, and we just came home with treatment and a bill that was more than fair and honest! This is unheard of in 45 years of consultations for the various animals I've cared for! I can't believe it! The whole team is wonderful, fantastic, magical! What humanity! Bravo! The whole neighborhood feels safe knowing you're there for our animals!
I received a warm welcome and was a little apprehensive as it was my cat's first time. Everything went smoothly and I received some excellent advice. I highly recommend it.
Relaxed vet, no pressure to do or buy anything. Friendly and available team and ultra-efficient equipment.
The staff are really warm and attentive. Thank you for the excellent service!
Very welcoming and kind staff, take the time to explain and educate.
Great experience overall, staff is very kind and attentive!
I was very satisfied. Dr. Cuisinier asked thoughtful questions, explained everything clearly, and made me feel completely supported. Her compassion and patience truly stood out

From my very first call to this clinic, I knew we were dealing with caring and compassionate people. My little Bine had a urinary tract infection, and they saw us the same day even though we weren't regular clients. They were incredibly accommodating with our schedule, and their prices are very reasonable. I'm seriously considering switching to this veterinary clinic! Thank you again for taking such good care of our little darling!
Wonderful service! They are very attentive, warm, and lovely. I recommend them 1000%! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
This is the second time I've seen Dr. Cuisinier for my rabbit. She's a great listener and always gives excellent advice. I 100% recommend the clinic, which is very conveniently located.
Excellent welcome for a first visit
The vet and assistant are truly professional and reassuring! For stressed or slightly difficult animals, you can make an appointment without fear!
Attentive and caring staff. Very clean environment.
The team is very attentive.
Price was great, my cat was treated so well and we werealso assisted in spanish! The place is beautiful and clean and everyone is so kind!
I have a senior dog and we treat him with a lot of love.
Excellent service from Dr Garcia. It is very much appreciated.
The best!

A wonderful experience! Aslan needed to be seen quickly, and Dr. Anna took him in without hesitation. She was very kind, professional, and reassuring, as was the entire team. He's doing much better now, and I'm so grateful to have had access to care so quickly, and for a fraction of the price I would have paid elsewhere. Thank you to the whole team! 🩷
Best veterinary clinic! Reasonable prices and wonderful customer service! I will be back for my second cat.
Great service!

We received amazing service! The technicians and veterinarians were incredibly empathetic and attentive. They answered all my questions and concerns and gave me all the information I needed for what to do next. My little cat Freddie is very anxious, and they knew how to put him at ease; he was in very good hands, which was incredibly reassuring! A huge thank you xx 🥹
5-star service, everyone was very friendly and incredibly patient.

As previous clients of Animal Care West in Dorval, we were so happy to see them open a new location just a few minutes from home.

We’ve visited twice since they opened for our dog Arya and both experiences have been exceptional. The staff is incredibly welcoming and the level of care has been amazing each time.

Dr. Zapata is so calm, compassionate, and genuinely passionate about what she does. She takes a thoughtful, logical approach to treatment and never recommends unnecessary testing. She takes the time to explain different options and follows up as needed.

They were also able to accommodate us without an appointment, and being open on Saturdays is such a huge bonus. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy veterinary team.

Exceptional clinic.

A highly competent, professional, and welcoming team. A huge thank you for your hospitality. Excellent service from reception to the consultation rooms. Thank you to Dr. Cuisinier, and I also wanted to thank the surgical technician, but I don't know her name. I sincerely wanted to leave this review; I had been going through hell for over a month regarding my cat's condition, and thanks to you, I feel confident again!
Great experience! Excellent service and an independent veterinary clinic. Welcome to the neighborhood!

Fantastic veterinary services! Fair prices, amazing, friendly staff. They genuinely care! I’ve been to different Animal Care locations and they’re all fantastic. Upon my first ever visit to Animal Care I immediately made them my primary veterinary clinic for my furry companions. I highly recommend them!
Highly competent veterinarian and I highly recommend him

My pet was seen and treated quickly, for a fraction of the price I was quoted elsewhere. The service was very courteous, the explanations clear, and the tone never pushy or judgmental—which often happens when you refuse services elsewhere. I was very pleased with my experience and will definitely return if needed. Thank you!
The vet gave us a very warm welcome; she was kind and patient with our dogs.

Impeccable service; they truly care about the animals. There's no pressure for expensive and unnecessary procedures like some other veterinarians might. They're independent, and that makes all the difference.
Very nice medical team that go above and beyond for your pet.
Awesome place if you love your pet.
The best vet I've ever seen. They are so kind, well done! I'm so glad I found you. Cléo thanks you.
The staff here are amazing! Friendly and helpful front staff and amazing care from Dr Cuisinier and tech Ahmed. Bedside manner so to speak it amazing, they really care about their patients.
A very positive experience; the veterinarian was very friendly and professional.

I had a great experience with this clinic when I brought my dog in for his neutering. Everything went very smoothly, and the team did a wonderful job. The clinic was convenient, the staff were kind, professional, and reassuring, and they took excellent care of him. He recovered really well and seemed comfortable afterward, which gave me a lot of peace of mind. I’m very happy with the experience and would definitely recommend this vet clinic.
THANKS!
I think I've found my favorite veterinary clinic!!! A wonderful team, down-to-earth and attentive to their clients, but especially to their patients ❤️ Thank you so much!!!!

Thank you for your excellent care, advice, and gentleness during my cat's final moments. I hope to visit you again someday with another pet, and I've recommended you to my local friends. Thank you to the whole team.

Dr. Cuisinier and her team were extraordinary. They were very kind, caring, and competent, and immediately put me at ease during the palliative surgery to remove a cancerous mass from my 13-year-old standard poodle. I am very grateful for their compassion, professionalism, and the care they provided to my companion.
A lovely clinic with excellent staff, such as Ana and Mathieu!
I’m really happy with this veterinary clinic! The staff is friendly, and the vet is knowledgeable and caring.

Dr Anita Cuisinier has been our vet for over a decade and has performed multiple surgeries on our pets, including dentals, sterilizations, and emergency surgeries. She is as knowledgeable as she is skilled (highly!). Unfortunately our pets can't live forever, but she has been there every step of the way, guiding us with empathy and expertise. 5/5, would recommend!

A veterinary clinic just like we've all been searching for!

What a wonderful discovery Vet Care Little Italy is! From the moment you walk in, you feel enveloped in a warm, well-maintained, and truly welcoming environment. The staff is competent, friendly, and attentive; you immediately feel you're in good hands.

A huge thank you to Dr. Cuisinier, a truly exceptional general practitioner. Professional, attentive, and caring, she took the time to fully understand our pet's situation and clearly explain the available options. What particularly touched me was that she offered us several solutions tailored to our budget, without ever compromising the quality of care. This human and personalized approach makes all the difference! We left with a smile and, above all, with the confidence of having found our trusted veterinary clinic. I recommend it without hesitation!

First veterinary experience for my little dog Rio since we arrived in Quebec. From the moment we entered the clinic, the welcome was warm and Rio felt completely at ease. I was delighted by the kindness of every member of staff who reassured me when my dog ​​had to undergo general anesthesia. The veterinarian performed a thorough examination and answered all my questions. The clinic is very cozy, and I appreciated the family atmosphere compared to larger clinics that can feel impersonal. I recommend them without hesitation, both for the professionalism and the empathy of all the staff. Thank you so much for your excellent care!
Super friendly and highly professional, you can tell they love animals. For me, they are the best vets you will find. They explain everything clearly, I highly recommend them.

The best!
They were so kind to me and my furry friend, and they provided service in Spanish and also speak other languages.
The prices are reasonable and the place is fantastic, 10/10!
Excellent professionals, serious and animal lovers. Very respectful treatment at all times. Superb facilities. Wishing the clinic much success.
Top pet care!

We took our little cat Tofu to this clinic during our visit to Montreal because of a minor digestive issue that's quite common in cats, and we couldn't be happier with the experience.

We were seen by Matt and Anna, two exceptional professionals who put us at ease from the very first moment. Their experience is evident, and they have excellent rapport with both animals and their owners.

The clinic is modern, clean, and very well-equipped, which immediately reassured us. They explained everything clearly and took care of Tofu with great care and gentleness.

Without a doubt, if we lived in Montreal, this would be our go-to veterinary clinic. Even though we were only passing through, we left very grateful for their hospitality. Highly recommended!
A very modern clinic with very attentive professionals. Dr. García was very kind to my dog, and it's great that she speaks Spanish. I highly recommend her.
Thank you to veterinarians Mathieu Escalon and Ana Garcia for their advice and care for our pet.

I had an excellent experience with Dr. Escalon. He is a true professional who took the time to answer all of our questions with incredible patience. His diagnosis was spot on, and we felt very confident in the care our pet received. While the prices are not especially cheap, they are very reasonable for the high quality of service provided. A huge plus is that Dr. Escalon speaks Spanish, which made the whole process much smoother and more comfortable for us. Highly recommended!
We had a wonderful experience for our boys' annual check-up! Beautiful clinic, impeccable service and super attentive staff 😌! …

First visit to this vet for my little cat Lola, and I'm so relieved to have found someone so kind and competent. Dr. Mathieu Escalon was gentle, patient, and very clear in his explanations. Lola was reassured (and so was I 😅). Thank you for your kindness and professionalism! …
